rss: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
title: Tech Toys Take a Tumble
story: In the world of high-tech toys, some companies are spending a lot on new gadgets, which is making their toy robots and VR goggles a bit wobbly in the market.
storyBig: Tech companies are investing heavily in artificial intelligence, leading to an industry-wide decline in stock prices as investors worry about the sustainability of this spending trend.
think: What could happen if companies spend too much on new technology?
bull: New gadgets can make games more exciting.
bear: Spending a lot might make some toys too pricey.

rss: How video game remakes tap the power of nostalgia
title: Old Games Make a Comeback!
story: Video game companies are bringing back old games that kids and parents loved. It's like playing your favorite game with new surprises!
storyBig: Video game developers are capitalizing on nostalgia by releasing remakes of classic games, engaging both new players and those who played the originals, leading to increased sales and market interest.
think: Why do you think people enjoy playing old games again?
bull: Remakes can bring fun and familiar games back to life.
bear: If too many old games are remade, new ideas might be missed.
